title: 9M Analysis: Synthetic pump fire, 2024
audience: Investigators and the teams designing corrective and preventive actions
status: Learning purposes: not a statutory document

bottom_line.text: Two of the nine Ms are relevant: Method (M3) and Maintenance (M9). The other seven have no condition in this export.
The seals were bought without a specification (M9), and that fed the missing return-to-service guidance (M3): one learning, counted once.
Both directions of change are at the engineering tier. No owner or date is set here: the organisation fills them in the blank actions sheet.

data_quality.text: One fact came from the organisation at the interview, not from the export: it is in Context supplied by the organisation, uncited.

rows: M9.07 Spare Parts and Inventory Management

items.lesson: The joint went back into service without a test because no procedure asked for one.
items.explanation: Subcategory M3.02 Standard Operating Procedures: the procedure index has no return-to-service entry [EVD-0002]. System driver: the spares programme (OR 2.2, level 4) feeds the missing guidance (SV 1.4). Barrier state: absent.

lint_ok.reason: the barrier records the control that existed; the change is at the engineering tier

items.change: Corrective: interlock the pump restart on a recorded leak test of the disturbed joint.
items.indicator: Restarts after seal work with a recorded leak test

items.lesson: Seals were bought locally with no specification to buy against.
items.explanation: Subcategory M9.07 Spare Parts and Inventory Management: local seals without specification since March 2022 [EVD-0003]. System driver: the spares programme itself (OR 2.2, level 4). Barrier state: absent.

items.change: Preventive: the stores system refuses to receive a pressure-boundary seal without a specification number.
items.indicator: Seals held at goods receipt for a missing specification

items.question: Which purchase records show when the original seal specification was last used?
items.why: It would date the start of the local buying (FND-0003).
items.good_evidence: Purchase order history for the seal part number

rows: The technician followed the work order; the gap was the missing procedure (M3)
No finding points to the work environment
No finding points to goals or production pressure
No finding points to measurement or monitoring
The spares budget is the M9 condition, not counted twice
The user judged the alarm design out of scope for this review
The seal itself was sound; the gap was buying without a specification (M9)

nodes.label: M9 Maintenance: seals bought without a specification

items.text: The site works two 12-hour shifts, and seal changes are done on the day shift (supplied by the HSE lead at the interview).
